parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem:
The names of four particles are listed below.

alpha     beta-plus     neutron     proton

State the name(s) of the particle(s) in this list that:

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: do not experience an electric force when situated in an electric field

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: has the largest ratio of charge to mass.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: A hadron has a charge of $+e$ where $e$ is the elementary charge. The hadron is composed of only two quarks. One of these quarks is an antidown ($\bar{d}$) quark. By considering charge, state and explain the name (flavour) of the other quark.
